name: Requiem of the Dark Lord
summary:
Ever wanted to be the antagonist?.. Have you ever envied those isekai heroes from anime or games who, in a single moment, become powerful, respected, and popular? The hero of our story could never have dreamed of such a fate.

Falling into the world of his favorite game, the one he devoted years of his life to, sounds like a blessing. But can you still call it a blessing after what Ryu must endure in his new life? When the whole world wants to swallow you and digest you, leaving no chance to escape. Is it fate, or the design of higher powers? It no longer matters, because this world is destined to drown in blood.

**I will create a new world without grudges or prohibitions. I will create it only for those who truly need it. I will create a new world, even if I must destroy the old one. The world is in my hands now!**
